section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the study's findings, affirming that gratitude is significantly related to better self-reported physical health, specifically perceived somatic symptoms. It presents novel evidence that gratitude predicts enhanced physical health by reducing subjective perceptions of loneliness and perceived stress, which act as serial mediators. The authors acknowledge limitations due to the sample and cross-sectional design, recommending future experimental and longitudinal studies.
